items.title: Upload certified bachelor's certificate and final transcript
items.quote: Please upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal no later than 14 December 2026.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the documents must be uploaded: 14 December 2026. This is a specific date printed in the letter, not a period to be counted, so it is taken as written. No deemed-delivery or BGB period-counting rules apply (this is a private university's administrative deadline, not an authority's statutory period), so no weekend/holiday shift is applied to the printed date itself.

warnings: If 14 December 2026 falls on a weekend, the applicant portal itself may or may not accept late uploads on the next business day; the letter gives no grace period, so submitting a day or two earlier is advisable to be safe.
